attchmntText: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors took the results on record following a review by the Audit and Risk Management Committee. Revenue from operations was Rs. 171.11 crores for the quarter and Rs. 329.61 crores for the six-month period. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 19.99 crores for the quarter and Rs. 34.89 crores for the six months. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.94 for the quarter and Rs. 1.64 for the six months. The company reported total income of Rs. 172.85 crores for the quarter. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were Rs. 2,026.75 crores. The Board meeting occurred on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has scheduled an investors and analysts call for the financial results of the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 04:00 P.M. Indian Standard Time. Management representatives include Ms. Priya Paul, Mr. Vijay Dewan, and Mr. Manish Bhagat. Dial-in details are available via the company website and the enclosed annexure. Participants are requested to join five to ten minutes prior to the scheduled time.

attchmntText: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release regarding launch of  Zone Connect by The Park , Mathura'.
voiceSummary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited announced the launch of Zone Connect by The Park Mathura on November 10, 2026. The new hotel is located on Masani Delhi Link Road and features 42 rooms across three categories. It includes an all-day dining restaurant and an indoor events space with a capacity of 150 guests. The property aims to strengthen the brand's presence in emerging leisure, cultural, and pilgrimage markets. This expansion reinforces the company's strategy to grow its hospitality footprint across India's prominent religious destinations. The announcement was filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited for information purposes.
